name: C6 3D as a document
description: Slices C6 and E6: on an isolated fixture with one placed part synced to the PCB, View › Go to 3D opens the 3D view as its own document tab with its own menu set (no Place menu; camera presets, projection, measure, cross-probe). The properties panel lists the IR stack-up (2 copper layers and the dielectric of a new project), the board's solder mask from the project, and the part as a labelled placeholder (no 3D model attached). Selecting the part offers model assignment and cross-probing: Show in PCB opens the PCB editor. Back in 3D, the board label, the projection toggle, a side preset from the View menu, Reset and the measure tool drive the WebGL view, and the stack-up explode separates the copper layers (E1/W2-K: the view draws the engine board geometry DRC checks); these last steps need WebGL in the window and come after a step that checks it.
